This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
to be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title 
block

There are two drainage pumps one in the North main sump tank and the other in 
the South main sump tank and their types are CP3300 ( used for draining the main sump 
tanks )

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abd Elnabi Ibrahim, revised and tested by eng. Al-Sayed Ibrahim Al-Ashmony, accepted 
by eng. Abd elghaffar Osman: general director, and approved by eng. Ahmed 
Mohamed Yonis; Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1 & 2 Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director 
and MPIS Coordinator.
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Torque wrench, wrench with different sizes and feeler gauge.

Special tools as mechanical seal, ball bearing ... etc.

Slinging wench "3 ton" upward the sump tank for lifting and lowering the 
 submersible pumps in the sump tank
Cleaning articles ( fluid, rags, .. etc )
Oil drainage pump.

Make sure that the 
 lifting equipment is in good condition.

Get out the pump from the 
 sump.

Check the condition of 
 carrying handle, lifting eyes, chains and wire cables.

Check that the guide bars 
 are vertical.

Rinse the pump thoroughly 
 with clean water before starting work, good clean of the outer pump surface

Clean the pass of cooling 
 pump system.

Check the pump casing and 
 impeller.

Check the clearance 
 between the impeller skirt and the pump casing ( not exceeds 2mm) if it 
 exceeds 2mm replacing the wear ring ( 5 ).

Check the condition of 
 oil through the oil hole screw ( 8 ).

Take some of oil from the bottom of oil casing and sure 
 that no water mixed with oil, then check that the oil reaches up to oil 
 hole.

If there is water mixed with oil. the oil then became 
 cream-like and oil must be change ( about 8 liters )

Replace a new O ring ( 8 ), good tightness for the oil plug 
 (8).

Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
to be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title 
block
There are two drainage pumps one in the North main sump tank and the other in 
the South main sump tank and their types are CP3300 ( used for draining the main sump

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abd Elnabi Ibrahim, revised and tested by eng. Al-Sayed Ibrahim Al-Ashmony, accepted 
by eng. Abd elghaffar Osman: general director, and approved by eng. Ahmed 
Mohamed Yonis; Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1 & 2 Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director 
and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
